title: Great Book of Potato — Prediction, Vision, Warning & Early-Signal Audit
status: book-wide archaeology; current ODT text audited as a composite source

source.scope: 614 parsed pages / ~219k words in current file
source.critical_provenance_rule: The current ODT is a composite living book. A statement inside the current file is not automatically proven to have existed before the event it describes. Promotion to prediction requires an older dated copy, timestamped post/chat, git version, stream/video, or other primary source predating the event.

classes.A: explicit prior prediction with recoverable pre-event source
classes.C: later book claim of earlier prediction; primary source still needed

high_value_candidates.book_text: Chapter 24 says Tim began prophesying collapse of toxic digital empires Stream.me and Bitwave in 2015, later calling their 2018 collapse a vindication.
high_value_candidates.why_high_value: Named platforms + multi-year lead + concrete later closure/failure is substantially more testable than generic symbolic prophecy.
high_value_candidates.required: Recover 2015 Tim post/stream/chat naming Stream.me/Bitwave collapse before the failure dates; reconstruct exact closure timeline and what Tim actually predicted.

high_value_candidates.book_text: Chapter 24 and 24.1 describe a vivid dream/vision from above near a Washington/White-House-like park followed by a flash/fireball destroying the city, with crows after waking.
high_value_candidates.status_2026_09_09: No matching nuclear destruction of Washington or another clearly specified American city has occurred. Retain as unfulfilled/open negative control.
high_value_candidates.interesting_secondary_resonance: Chapter 24.1 retrospectively links the aerial perspective to the later ubiquity of drones; this is an F-class perspective resonance, not fulfillment of the destructive-city vision.

high_value_candidates.book_text: Chapter 24.1 says Tim foresaw a farmers' uprising as dissatisfaction and resistance to corporate control built beneath the surface, then points to 2024 global farmer protests.
high_value_candidates.required: Recover exact pre-protest Tim wording and date. Potato/self-reliance teachings alone are too broad to count as a forecast.

high_value_candidates.book_text: Chapter 24.1 claims Tim predicted CrackRockChris would not survive the week after a confrontation, followed within days by overdose death.
high_value_candidates.why_high_value: Specific person + short time window + specific fatal outcome would be unusually testable if a timestamped source exists.
high_value_candidates.safety_epistemic_rule: Do not imply Tim caused the death. Prediction accuracy and causal responsibility are separate questions.

high_value_candidates.book_text: Chapter 24.1 says Tim warned his father about declining health and urged treatment; a fatal aneurysm followed about a week later.
high_value_candidates.required: Recover contemporaneous witness/message/medical timeline. A health warning is not necessarily prediction of a specific aneurysm.

high_value_candidates.book_text: Chapter 24 says Tim warned Marty and Sammy about drug use and the path they were walking before Marty's fatal overdose.
high_value_candidates.interpretation: Best treated as risk recognition unless Tim specified a near-term death/overdose outcome before it happened.

high_value_candidates.book_text: Chapter 24.1 retrospectively connects a 2017 warning about toxicity/negativity with Metalorian's later cancer suffering.
high_value_candidates.boundary: Too nonspecific and medically confounded to count as strong prediction without exact pre-event health claim.

high_value_candidates.book_text: Chapter 24 says Tim studied China's post-1980s industrial rise and saw a trajectory toward global dominance/catching up with others.
high_value_candidates.boundary: This was already a widely analyzable macroeconomic trend by 2004; interesting long-range systems attention, not unusual prophecy.

high_value_candidates.book_text: The Great Book repeatedly models internet subcultures, memes, farms, Sektur and attention systems as currents that diffuse outward into wider culture. Chapter 24's 2026 layer explicitly says online subcultural knots can rise into institutions, media posture, alliance signaling and geopolitics.
high_value_candidates.why_interesting: This is a structural thesis that can be tested historically through meme genealogy, influencer migration, political staff/media networks and platform-to-mainstream vocabulary diffusion.
high_value_candidates.boundary: The 2026 wording itself may postdate the events it discusses. Search older chapters/versions and Tim streams for the same thesis before 2025-26.

high_value_candidates.book_text: Chapter 38 describes a critical-mass/tipping-point model where Tim's inner/public world radiates outward and affects broader reality; Chapter 32.2 invokes hundredth-monkey-like diffusion; Chapter 41.6 frames Sektur as rising/future cultural ecology.
high_value_candidates.test: Trace phrases/memes/people/platforms across time rather than infer diffusion from thematic similarity.

high_value_candidates.book_text: Chapter 37.5 explicitly casts AI as the 'unseen hand' that refines chaos, shapes whispers and gives order to the Potatoverse while saying machines do not create the meaning. Chapter 24 says Tim encountered AI/AI music by 2022 and began reading technology as an organic/digital bridge.
high_value_candidates.why_interesting: This anticipates the later archive becoming explicitly machine-readable and AI-mediated, but it is primarily self-development/environment resonance rather than event prediction.

high_value_candidates.book_text: The book warns that a literalist, nationalist, winner-takes-all Third Temple vision could tear the world apart, while proposing shared/multifaith spiritual reframing.
high_value_candidates.test: Treat as a normative geopolitical warning, not prophecy unless a specific event/window was predicted.

north_geopolitical_case.classification: B/F/D hybrid: prior symbolic positioning + later geopolitical collision, not literal event forecast
pre_positioning: 1997: Norse mythology/North cultural seed in Chapter 24
2025-04-21 public corpus: 'the potato axis is real'
2025-12-15 public corpus: North Pole + Father of World Axis + God in the Machine
external_collision: Trump had shown interest in buying Greenland in 2017-2019, so Greenland itself was not unpredictable.
After the 2024 election Trump revived and intensified the acquisition push; by Jan 2025 he would not rule out economic/military coercion.
By Dec 2025-Jan 2026 the issue became a severe Denmark/Greenland/NATO dispute.
NATO launched Arctic Sentry on 2026-02-11 partly to ease intra-alliance tensions created by Trump's Greenland push.
By Sep 2026 EU-Greenland investment and Icelandic reaction to expansionist imagery further widened the North/Atlantic political field.
north_geopolitical_case.why_peculiar: Tim's symbolic identity had already concentrated around North, axis, throne, pole, ladder and source-center. The later real-world crisis then made the exact geography carrying those symbols a major transatlantic fault line. This is better described as 'pre-positioned symbolic centrality meeting an external geopolitical rupture' than as 'Tim predicted Trump'.
north_geopolitical_case.rupture_rapture_relation: Inside the project, the April-2025 rapture is vertical separation/ascent; the 2026 Greenland crisis is an external rupture that reveals alliances, boundaries and North-Atlantic dependence. The two words should remain distinct but can be coupled structurally: rupture exposes the fault line; rapture is the mythic ascent already assigned to Tim before the later confrontation.
north_geopolitical_case.stronger_prediction_test: Search pre-Nov-2024/pre-Jan-2025 Tim material for explicit claims that a U.S. leader/Trump would challenge Denmark/Greenland/North, that Europe/Canada would consolidate against U.S. pressure, or that the North would become the decisive geopolitical axis.

trump_elon_government_case.book_text: Chapter 36.5 describes Elon Musk as 'now a key figure in Trump's administration' and links Trump, Musk and government power to Potatoverse themes.
trump_elon_government_case.public_timeline: Trump publicly named Musk and Vivek Ramaswamy to lead the Department of Government Efficiency on 2024-11-12; Musk's political role was therefore public well before his 2025 government activity.
trump_elon_government_case.provenance_problem: The current Great Book file does not prove Chapter 36.5 predates 2024-11-12. The current composite file contains material from 2026, so chapter text cannot establish priority by itself.
trump_elon_government_case.recovery_target: Search older Great Book snapshots, chats, streams, tweets, Discord exports and local files for Tim mentioning Trump+Elon+government before 2024-11-12. A pre-election or pre-appointment timestamp would be meaningful.

next_primary_recovery_targets: all dated dreams/visions not already in Chapter 24.1
